description: Audit a robots.txt file line-by-line. Detects syntax errors, empty user-agent groups, orphan Allow/Disallow lines, non-slash paths, non-numeric Crawl-delay values, unofficial Noindex usage, and wildcard traps. Also summarizes AI-bot coverage across 50+ known AI crawlers. Provide EITHER url (to fetch and audit) OR text.

text.description: Raw robots.txt text to audit directly (alternative to url).

url.description: URL of the site whose /robots.txt should be fetched and audited.

name: validate_robots
title: Validate robots.txt
